result.stdout:
Usage: ai-bridge [command]
Commands:
  pack                - Packs source files into text context for AI (auto-initializes on first run).
  apply [options]     - Applies ai-response.xml patches to the codebase.

Apply Options:
  --dry-run           - Preview changes without modifying files.
  --force             - Apply even if there are uncommitted changes in target files.
